🆕 NEW RELEASE: The Offspring cover The Vandals' Oi To The World!

The Offspring have released a cover of The Vandals' holiday song Oi To The World!, out since 9 November 2026 via Concord Records. It is a standalone single and not tied to a new album. The band's latest full-length remains Supercharged from October 2024.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Thirty Seconds To Mars announce 2027 European tour

Thirty Seconds To Mars play A Beautiful Lie and This Is War on a 17-date European tour from 6 April to 1 May 2027. German shows are Munich, Frankfurt, Berlin, Hannover and Cologne, and former member Tomo Miličević rejoins the band.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Citizen and Enter Shikari join Vainstream 2027 bill

Citizen and Enter Shikari have been added to the bill of Vainstream Rockfest 2027. The festival takes place in Münster on 25 and 26 June 2027, and Enter Shikari are booked for the Friday.
